merged.task: Use the top-right search bar to look up the term “privacy policy,” open the official Privacy Policy page, and note three categories of personal information the site says it collects from visitors. Only use http://foxnews.com to achieve this task.

From the FoxNews.com homepage, navigate to the “About” or “Corporate Information” page and list the year Fox News Channel was launched, the name of its founder, and the city in which its headquarters is located. Only use http://foxnews.com to achieve this task.

In the site footer, locate the “Contact Us” or “Fox News Careers” link. Open it and note two different job categories or departments that the careers page lists as hiring (e.g., Production, Technology). Only use http://foxnews.com to achieve this task.

Click “Health” in the main navigation, select a nutrition-focused article, and summarize the key dietary recommendation highlighted in that piece using no more than 20 words. Only use http://foxnews.com to achieve this task.

Navigate to the “Podcasts” link in the site’s main or footer navigation, then list the distinct podcast categories (such as Politics, True Crime, Lifestyle, etc.) and provide one podcast title that appears under each category. Only use http://foxnews.com to achieve this task.

From the Templates section, open the “All Templates” gallery, filter by the “Photography” category, choose any one template, and list every pre-designed page type (e.g., Gallery, About, Contact) that the template’s detail panel claims to include. Only use http://squarespace.com to achieve this task.
